summary: Courses / 课程 UX/UI reconstruction from Owner Production screenshot. V2.47.160 restores the existing Learning Center contract that shared mature CSS had visually overridden: the large dashboard-like hero/stats become a compact factual header rail, category chips return to a lightweight context rail, Continue Learning remains first but is compressed into one focused row, and the course catalog becomes a two-column learning index with real book covers instead of a boxed card wall. Repetitive synthetic description copy is removed when no real course description exists. A terminal course-library.css now loads after shared mature/shell layers so Courses body geometry has one final owner, while Navigation / Shared Shell appearance itself is unchanged. Canonical books storage, course state/local completion semantics, frozen Channels/Watch/Topics, schema/data/auth/security/provider/updater mechanisms are unchanged. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies from the current continuous UI closure authorization; OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME remains POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED and OWNER_REAL_USE remains POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED. Production remains Owner manual.
